methods: expressing y in terms of x
solving for x in terms of y
statement: Find the range of the function $f(x)=\dfrac{2x+1}{x-1}$ for $x>1$.
solution: Let $y=\frac{2x+1}{x-1}$. Solving for $x$: $y(x-1)=2x+1$, so $x(y-2)=y+1$, giving $x=\frac{y+1}{y-2}$. For $x>1$ we require $\frac{y+1}{y-2}>1$, i.e. $\frac{y+1-(y-2)}{y-2}=\frac{3}{y-2}>0$, so $y>2$. Hence the range is $(2,\infty)$.
